messages.subject: Efficient rmr techniques updated
parts:
Hi, 
I rewrote the rmr section in the Efficient rmr techniques page. Instead of describing the things being done internally in rmr to improve speed, which was never the goal of that document, it tries to explain how to write fast rmr programs  as it is related to specific rmr features and implementation decisions (the sections about the more general Hadoop and R efficiency techniques are largely unchanged). Please take a look a let me know what you think. Thanks


Antonio
